<<A>> TIE ROD END DISCONNECTION
CAUTION
• Loosen the nut from the ball joint instead of removing 
it.
• Hang special tool MB991113 or MB990635 with ropes to 
prevent it from falling.
Use special tool MB991113 or MB990635 to disconnect the ball 
joint.
<<B>> GEAR BOX ASSEMBLY REMOVAL
CAUTION
Be sure not to damage the bellows and the tie rod end dust 
cover when removing the gear box assembly.
